content: Pattern for AUTOSAR XML Schema location hint URI The AUTOSAR XML Schema location hint URI in the AUTOSAR XML description shall be the file name of a XML Schema document provided by AUTOSAR. This file name follows the pattern: AUTOSAR_{number}.xsd {number} corresponds to the specific AUTOSAR release the given AUTOSAR XML Schema belongs to. In particular no path shall be part of the AUTOSAR XML Schema location hint URI .
